ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: 3/3/6/2/30. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which are required for a public purpose. Land acquisition for building the office OIC (officer-in-charge) of Visal Matale Water Project at Ukuwela. Description of the land to be acquired: An allotment No. 01 in extent 0.1522 Hectares, of the land in Preliminary Plan No. Mu.P.Ma. 1780 prepared by the surveyor superintendent, of, Matale situated at Ukuwela village in Ukuwela Grama Niladhari Division, Matale Udasiyapathtuwe in Divisional Secretary Division of Ukuwela in the District of Matale Central Province.

Lot No. 01 Claimant: Government; Original Claimant: Shanthi Munasinghe Samagi Mawatha, Ukuwela; Land Extent: 0.1522 Hectare All persons interested in the aforesaid Lands on are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Ukuwela at 9.30 a. m. on 04.12.2019. And hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 20.11.2019 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
S. N. K. SERASINGHE, Divisional Secretary, Ukuwela.
25th October, 2019, At Ukuwella Divisional Secretariat, Ukuwela.

Amendment THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference the Gazette No. 14644 dated 21.01.1966. Description of the land to be acquired: Preliminary Plan No. Co 93, Village - Ahugammana, Divisional Secretariat - Mahara District - Gampaha. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Millagahawatta; Extent: 00 acres, 00 roods, 23.7 perches Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Madalanda; Extent: 02 acres, 00 roods, 01.5 perches The time given for all persons those who are interested in the aforesaid land by that Gazette notification is amended as follows;

Accordingly all persons interested in the aforesaid land are here by required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Mahara Divisional Secretariat on the 20th November 2019 at 10.00 a.m. Further you are hereby requested to notify me in writing in duplicate on or before the 13th November 2019, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation, for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount in duplicate. The deed and other documents in proof of the title should be submitted at the inquairy. . G. S. I. WIMALASENA, Divisional Secretary, Land Acquiring Officer Mahara.
29th October, 2019, Mahara Divisional Secretariat, Ranmuthugala, Kadawatha.
